subject: Exploratory: pathway slab visualizer for per-route cost vs tail-latency
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: lena@acme.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploratory: pathway slab visualizer for per-route cost vs tail-latency

Hi team —

Quick ask from Console/Product: can we prototype a small visual exploration tool for the Console that lets operators decompose a route’s economics vs latency distribution? I sketched a lightweight concept and attached a wireframe (pathway-slab-wireframe-v1.png). The idea is a bubblemap where each bubble is a downstream pathway (route + model variant + quant profile) plotted with:

- x-axis: 95th/99th tail latency (ms)
- y-axis: normalized token cost per call (USD)
- bubble size: traffic volume (qps or requests)
- color: error rate or fallback percentage

Primary goals:
- Give SREs and customers a single view to spot high-cost, high-tail-latency call chains.
- Make it easy to drill down from bubble -> time-series + example traces + top prompts.
- Expose quick filters: model variant, quantization profile, region, tenant slice.

Asks:
1) Product: does this live as a new Console tile or within the Route Diagnostics flow? (I lean tile for exploratory ops).
2) Infra/Telemetry: what is the minimum telemetry schema we need to compute 95/99 latencies by pathway and map tokens->USD at query time? See sample export attached (sample-telemetry-export.csv).
3) UX: quick feedback on the wireframe and any strong objections.

Timeline: would like a lightweight prototype for the internal alpha by Apr 28. No fancy backend initially — a time-bounded job that materializes aggregates (day/hour) is fine.

Notes on scope: this is NOT the route-cost-charges product yet — think diagnostics/ops-first. Keep retention short for prototype (30 days) unless infra asks otherwise.

Thanks — will sync on a quick 30-min later today if helpful.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Product Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference

This is doable as a prototype but need to call out a few infra constraints up front: 

1) Telemetry surface: to compute per-pathway 95/99 we need event-level timing that includes: route_id, model_id, variant_id, quant_profile, tenant_id, request_start_ms, request_end_ms, token_count_input, token_count_output, fallback_flag, region. If we don't have variant/quant in the event we can only do route-level aggregations.

2) Cost mapping: we can map tokens->USD using current pricing table but it’s an offline join on aggregates; small delta for streaming only. Also need to decide whether to show cost-per-token vs cost-per-call.

3) Retention & cost: materializing hourly aggregates across all routes for 30-day window is ~N TB/day depending on partitioning. For prototype I'd recommend the tenant opt-in approach + sampling (1% baseline or sampling high-cost paths higher).

Action items from infra: 
- I will add a short export job that emits hourly aggregates with the schema I listed (SUP-1912).
- Need UX to confirm: which dimensions absolutely required for the first pass (I suggest model_variant + region + tenant_slice).

Attachments: sample-telemetry-export.csv (small dump from last-week).

-Ben
